text:
maya: Quick sync: AcmeHW wants to exercise a "what-if" replay tomorrow to validate offline device batch delivery and see how credits would have been applied. Theyre anxious about duplicate deliveries from flaky networks.

jared: Ok. We need to make sure two things: idempotency key handling and the ledger reconciliation preview UI for partners. Do we have an example of a duplicate idempotent_id arriving with different timestamps?

priya: We do. Samples uploaded: s3://partner-tests/acmehw/dup-scenarios/ — contains `usage_hourly.json`, `usage_minutely_ms.json`, `entitlement_activate_then_use.json`, and `late_arrival_patch.json`. The ledger preview delta is in `expected_deltas.csv`.

infra-bot: sandbox: replay-service v1.14 deployed to sandbox. Endpoints: `POST https://sandbox.redwood.com/internal/replay` and `POST https://sandbox.redwood.com/marketplace/webhook` for live delivery. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/pipelines/marketplace/4591 (tests: 18 passed, 2 warnings).

maya: Important: partner will send `X-Partner-Signature: sha256=<hex>`, `idempotent_id`, and optional `replay_hint":"true"` in the body for their own tracing. We should ignore `replay_hint` for crediting unless `replay_mode=allow_duplicates` is used.

jared: For the replay harness we can surface two modes: `safe` (default) which enforces idempotency and `allow_duplicates` (what-if) which temporarily bypasses the idempotent write gate and marks ledger rows as preview-only (no billing). Implementation note: flag `?mode=allow_duplicates&preview=true`.

priya: Preview-only is preferred. Partner must explicitly opt-in to commit duplicates. Otherwise we risk double charging. We also need a short playbook for how to flip preview->commit and audit logs for approval.

akshay: Small gotcha: AcmeHW devices sometimes reuse `device_id` across factory resets. Their `idempotent_id` is unique per event, but they occasionally reissue the same idempotent_id for resend with corrected usage_units. Our system currently accepts the latest cryptographically-signed payload for a given idempotent_id. We should confirm partner will sign the corrected event with a new signature.

maya: We asked them to preserve monotonic `idempotent_id` per unique occurrence; their SDK will now append a resend suffix `-r1` on retries.

devops: Can someone paste a minimal curl we can give partners for the sandbox? Also include expected header format for signature so their ops can validate locally.

jared: Here's the curl to put in the partner runbook:

```
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.com/marketplace/webhook \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "X-Partner-Signature: sha256=$(echo -n '{\"idempotent_id\":\"evt-20250401-01\",\"device_id\":\"acme-42\",\"usage_units\":30,\"timestamp\":1712054400}' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac 'PARTNER_SECRET' -hex | sed 's/^.* //')" \\n  -d '{"idempotent_id":"evt-20250401-01","device_id":"acme-42","usage_units":30,"timestamp":1712054400,"event_type":"usage"}'
```

priya: Note on timestamps: partner may send ms epoch. Our webhook normalizer checks if `timestamp > 1e12` then divide by 1000. We also accept ISO-8601. Tests cover all three.

maya: Test plan for tomorrow: 1) run replay in `safe` mode (no commits) with real duplicate deliveries, confirm no ledger double-credit; 2) run `allow_duplicates` with `preview=true` to show partner potential deltas; 3) run `allow_duplicates` with `commit=true` only if partner signs an SLA/approval form.

infra-bot: replay job started: id `replay-20250401-acme-01`. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/replays/replay-20250401-acme-01/logs

jared: Ping me when logs are up. I'll validate idempotent handling and the reconciliation rows (match on idempotent_id, device_id, and billing_period).

akshay: Also check edge-case where `entitlement_activate` and immediate `usage` arrive in same batch. We must not apply usage until entitlement is active for that billing account. If they arrive within the same second, our ordering uses sequence numbers if provided, else server-received order. Include `sequence_no` in samples to avoid ambiguity.

maya: Good call. I updated the samples to include `sequence_no` for those tests.

priya: After the `preview` run we'll produce a reconciliation CSV and a partner-facing PDF explaining the deltas and recommended credits/adjustments.

devops: I'll coordinate a 30-min dry-run window at 09:30 PST and invite the partner SREs. Maya, can you confirm partner SRE Slack handle so I can DM invite?

maya: @acme-sre. Invite sent.

jared: Post-replay checklist: run `scripts/reconcile_preview.sh replay-20250401-acme-01` and attach output. Look for `UNMATCHED_EVENTS` and `DUP_CANDIDATES`.

maya: Great. Thanks team. I'll update the partner runbook and share the signed replay terms doc if they want to commit.

priya: :white_check_mark: Ill draft the commit SOP and put it behind an approvals flow (legal -> finance -> ops).

infra-bot: replay job finished: id `replay-20250401-acme-01`, status: preview_complete. Summary: 1,254 events processed, 23 duplicates detected (preview), 0 committed. Reconciliation CSV: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/partner-tests/acmehw/replays/replay-20250401-acme-01/recon.csv

devops: Logs look good. Moving partner to the dry-run channel now.
